concerns.text: Both T018 (full pipeline) and T023a (integrate PIT & CRPS into the full pipeline) are defined as producers of `results/distributional_metrics.csv`. The plan does not specify which task runs first, leading to a potential overwrite or race condition. To maintain a deterministic data flow, T023a must be executed **before** T018 (or T018 must be updated to incorporate the PIT/CRPS integration instead of being a separate producer).
